CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2662 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584. Bus nonce: 7dc3cd8e950fece88ea43c6226e0b789. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584` or `Fix review: blocked e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 7dc3cd8e950fece88ea43c6226e0b789`; then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else goes under `## Evidence`; the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2662 e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2662-7dc3cd8e`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer (adversarial, opus) for PR #2662, group R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 (part b, the cut-over), branch fix/r10-ci-layout-p2b, head e542446e725f703f2cfd51a35fbc987ed0d54584. The head is code head 4a83592e3 plus the delivery-row commit. This PR is on the critical path, and it changes CI and the required-check set for main, so a wrong verdict reddens or unguards main.

First read the group with jq from origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json (its brief, carries and resume), then the PR body. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Use the FINDER's harness that the group brief names, never the fixer's. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

Verify:
(1) The gate. The new single required check `gate` must fail when any unit it aggregates is red, skipped-when-required or cancelled. It must pass only when every required unit concluded success, or was legitimately skipped by its own scoping. Read the workflow source at the head and show each unit wired into gate's needs/evaluation; a unit left out is a hole. Demonstrate it with the body's U0 forced-red perturbation, or your own mutation of the gate logic: a red unit must make gate FAIL and name the unit. Add a null control in which every unit is green and gate passes.
(2) Coverage parity. Each of the 17 contexts the old ruleset requires maps to a unit that gate covers. List the mapping, and flag any old context with no counterpart or any check that is weaker.
(3) ruleset_cutover.py. Check that --disable changes only enforcement and --enable PUTs exactly [gate] with the integration id the body states. Check that --verify reads back, and that --rollback restores the staged copy (17 contexts, active) and is refused when the staged hash does not match. Read the code and its self-tests. Run only what has no network side effect, and NEVER call the GitHub ruleset API in write mode.
(4) The body's ## Unit refs. Spot-check at least 4 refs with git cherry or patch-id against the head, including at least two of the "re-cut" ones (u5, u6, u8, u9a, u9d, u10). Confirm the dropped probe commits (65f112ec5 and the B1/B2/Btwin commits) are absent from the head.
(5) ## Red checks. Every ancestry red is answered with a cause, the fixing commit and a cheaper detector. The three base-pinned governance reds (env-matrix, wave-script, policy-docs) are red only because the PR's base pins them; show that from the job logs, or the workflow's base-ref read. Read CI at this head with one bulk check-runs call.
(6) Hygiene. The three-dot diff `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD` matches the body's file list. tests/closure.py classifies each new tracked file (`tests/entities.py` passes). VERSION is untouched. The merge-tree against origin/main is clean. Head commits carry no Claude footers. Record the scoped-gate MODE line.

A finding that a later stage must act on carries to R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2, or to the group the brief names. Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API (bulk-list once, prefer git, stop on a 403); no Claude footers.
